items.title: Luis Conte interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 24, 2025
items.q: Interviewer introduces himself as Monk Rowe; Interviewee responds politely but does not mention any prior personal or professional relationship with Monk Rowe.

ctx.x: Luis was interviewed via Zoom on November 24, 2025 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive and I’m very pleased to have Luis Conte with me this afternoon – afternoon for me and you’re on the other coast, so thanks to technology we can sort of have a virtual handshake. Thank you for being here.
